```{r}
#| echo: false
#libraries

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
library(ggplot2)

API_KEY_PATH <- "API_KEY.txt"

api_key_param <- function(path = API_KEY_PATH) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return("")
  }
  key <- trimws(readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE))
  if (length(key) == 0 || key == "") "" else paste0("&key=", key)
}

LEVELS_RDS_PATH <- "data/pums_variable_levels.rds"
```

```{r}
#Gather data
valid_years=2021:2024
wanted_variables=c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP", "PWGTP",
            "FER", "HHL", "SCH", "SCHL", "SEX", "ST", "STATE",
            "REGION", "DIVISION")


dictionary_url = function(year) {
  paste0("https://api.census.gov/data/", year, "/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json")
}

get_variables=function(year){
  response=GET(dictionary_url(year))
  stop_for_status(response)

  parsed = fromJSON(rawToChar(response$content), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  
  all_vars=parsed$variables
  
  keep=intersect(wanted_variables,names(all_vars))
  
  lapply(all_vars[keep], function(var_info) {
    items  = var_info$values$item
    ranges = var_info$values$range
    list(
      label  = var_info$label,
      values = if (is.null(items)) character(0) else unlist(items),
      range  = if (is.null(ranges)) NULL else
        do.call(rbind, lapply(ranges, as.data.frame))
    )
  })
  }

build_levels_rds = function(years = valid_years, path = LEVELS_RDS_PATH) {
  levels_list = lapply(years, get_variables)
  names(levels_list) = as.character(years)
  
  dir.create(dirname(path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  saveRDS(levels_list, path)
  invisible(levels_list)
}



load_year_levels = function(year, path = LEVELS_RDS_PATH) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Could not find ", path, ". Run build_levels_rds() first.")
  }
  readRDS(path)[[as.character(year)]]
}


```

```{r}
if (!file.exists(LEVELS_RDS_PATH)) {
  build_levels_rds()
}
```
